deviations.description: Run a real /plan or /implement on a low-risk task
deviations.reason: A live dispatch right now would exercise the deployed .claude/ tree (a disposable artifact regenerated separately from the source store this task edits), not the source-store changes just made; this dispatch is itself a live in-flight /implement run of the same self-modifying system, so a nested live dispatch carries the self-modification risk the binding constraints caution against. Substituted with the fixture harness, which runs the actual modified source files end-to-end including the real update-task-status.sh write path.
